Definition: to lift; by implication, to impose
BiblicalUsage: The LORD offers David three things and tells him to choose the one He shall impose, and the isles are lifted up before Him as a very little thing.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that what God imposes is never more than I can bear, and what man calls great is very little in the hand that lifts the isles and lays a choice on a king.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
